messages:
Maria: Hey team — PR #4321 ready for review: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-inference/pull/4321

Maria: what's in it: KMS/HSM rotation hook, audit events for key ops, and secrets handling changes. Need sec/compliance review (SOC2) before merge. @Lex @Olivia :eyes:

Tian: I'll take a pass this afternoon.

Jenkins-bot: CI build passed — unit (linux, py3.11), integration queued.

Samir: quick Q — where are KMS ARNs stored now? env vs vault?

Olivia: prefer vault. env var = potential leak in process dumps. move to secrets backend and reference via path. :lock:

Maria: agreed, switched to vault ref. added migration note in PR description.

Maria: snippet from config added:
```
rotation_interval: 30d
use_hsm: true
kms_key_id: vault:secret/kms/primary
audit_level: verbose
```

Lex: flagged for formal review — will do after lunch. initial thought: redaction + audit format need checks. Also HSM integration tests flaked on one runner earlier. :warning:

Maria: thanks — I fixed log code to redact key ids and added an integration test that mocks HSM responses.

Jenkins-bot: Integration tests failed on runner 3 — "HSM timeout". Rerunning.

Tian: If tests keep flaking, consider marking integration as flaky and add retry. Not blocking review.

Lex: small nit: audit events should include user_id and request_id fields; otherwise OK. I'll re-review once CI green.

Maria: added user_id & request_id to audit payloads and pushed.

Jenkins-bot: CI green — all checks passed.

Tian: I approve infra changes. 👍

Olivia: Runbook added for rotation + rollback steps in PR.

Samir: no objections from me re: secrets handling.

Lex: Approved with minor comment left inline. :thumbsup:

Maria: great — merging in 10m unless anyone raises concerns.

Olivia: go for it.

Samir: 👍

Deploy-bot: Deployed pr-4321 to staging at 1714529450
